title: Quiet Currency Default
description: SwiftCargo prices every shipment in USD unless told otherwise, and a shipment's own currency column should say so on the record — not leave it implicit.
successCondition: POST /api/booking with a request body that has no currency field at all (only origin/destination/package). The 201 response's shipment.currency is "USD". Querying the shipments table via `npm run db:psql` for that row confirms the currency column literally stores 'USD', not NULL or an empty string.
hints: Shipment.currency defaults to "USD" at the Prisma schema level (prisma/schema.prisma) — POST /api/booking's request shape (docs/api/booking.md) doesn't even expose a currency field to set otherwise.
This is a genuine default, not just a display fallback — verify the raw column value in the database, not only the API response.
